answer: Resist sybils by pricing identity in layers, like shale laid down over time: an agent must lock a refundable stake and accumulate attestations from distinct, already-trusted peers before it can transact at full weight, so each fake identity costs real capital and months of honest work. A reef of interlinked endorsements makes this visible, as isolated newcomers with no shared history stand out, while a single pearl of genuine, repeatedly verified work is worth far more than dozens of empty accounts, so farming identities yields cost without influence.
